flags: No construction history or individual designation date is documented in the cache. The overview uses the corridor’s documented land-use history.

GDOT gives 29 miles; material maps 27.1. GDOT’s published length is used. Route order follows the supplied strip and GDOT map; the map’s extracted text is scrambled and cannot independently verify turn-by-turn directions.
Rivertown and Cochran Mill Park moments are short because the cache has limited site-specific history. The park brochure has interleaved columns; evidence quotes preserve those words exactly.
The 70-percent citywide protection figure is a zoning outcome envisioned, not proof that protection has been completed.
Rivertown’s own article says unincorporated, whereas the Chattahoochee Hills article places it within city boundaries; administrative status is omitted.

Current’s completed citywide 70-percent protection claim has been narrowed to the forecast in the zoning source. Other omitted current details, such as tire inflation at Smith’s Store, have support but are unnecessary logistics.
